comments.content: The `forced` tag is only detected when `lang_length >= 2` (the same condition guarding the hearing-impaired suffixes). This means filenames like `foo.forced.srt` (no language code) won't be detected as forced, which is inconsistent with how `forced` is typically used in practice. Consider whether the forced check should be independent of the language length requirement.
